people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Solomon
people.line: Son of David, king of Israel, known for his wisdom.

translations.web: They performed the duty of their God, and the duty of the purification, and so did the singers and the gatekeepers, according to the commandment of David, and of Solomon his son.
translations.bsb: They performed the service of their God and the service of purification, along with the singers and gatekeepers, as David and his son Solomon had prescribed.
translations.kjv: And both the singers and the porters kept the ward of their God, and the ward of the purification, according to the commandment of David, and of Solomon his son.
translations.asv: And they kept the charge of their God, and the charge of the purification, and so did the singers and the porters, according to the commandment of David, and of Solomon his son.
